settings.heading: Cancer Support
settings.subheading: Gentle, dermatologist-developed skincare to help your skin feel more comfortable during and after cancer treatment.
settings.intro: Cancer treatments such as chemotherapy, radiotherapy and targeted therapies can leave skin feeling dry, tight, sensitive and reactive. La Roche-Posay, developed alongside dermatologists and oncology healthcare professionals, offers simple, well-tolerated skincare to help restore comfort — so caring for your skin can be one less thing to worry about.
settings.note_body: Looking after your skin can bring a small sense of comfort and routine during a difficult time. Our team is here to help you choose gentle products that feel right for you.
